title: cross-company-80-day-priority-canvas
body:
Purpose
------
This is a compact working canvas to align the company on a single 80-day priority horizon (roughly two quarters) with a focus on: 1) a tight set of measurable company OKRs, 2) a slice of initiatives that move those OKRs, and 3) an all-hands + exec update cadence to socialize tradeoffs and callouts.

Context and constraints
-----------------------
- Macro: We are transitioning to Dedicated + Private push for enterprise; Q3 usage growth is healthy but margin pressure on hosted API.
- Constraint: hiring pace capped; limited infra spend headroom for new GPU bursts for next 80 days.
- Opportunity: Launch two optimized serving pipelines (kv-prefix cache + quantized variant) that can materially lower per-token cost for 1–2 high-volume customers.
- Decision window: Executive sign-off required for any >$250k infra commit and for changing public quotas.

Company-level North Star (80-day)
--------------------------------
Increase predictable revenue from Dedicated/Private commitments by 35% while holding hosted API unit cost increase to <8% quarter-over-quarter.

Candidate Company OKRs (draft)
----------------------------
OKR 1: Grow Dedicated/Private commercial momentum
- KR1.1: Close $5M in ARR (new and expansion) tied to Dedicated commitments by end of horizon
- KR1.2: Convert 4 leads to Private pilots with signed MOU
- KR1.3: Reduce onboarding time (sales->pilot) from 28d to 16d for Dedicated pilot flows

OKR 2: Improve inference economics on high-volume workloads
- KR2.1: Reduce per-token serving cost for top-10 customers by 22% via batching/caching/quantization
- KR2.2: Ship stable quantization profile testing harness and run against 12 production prompts
- KR2.3: Decrease p50 latency regression incidents to <=3 across all prod regions

OKR 3: Company trust and operational readiness
- KR3.1: Publish SLOs and on-call runbook for Dedicated with 30d retention of audit logs
- KR3.2: Achieve 95% positive sentiment in a post-all-hands pulse about clarity of priorities

Prioritized Initiatives (mapped to OKRs)
--------------------------------------
1) Dedicated Commercial Sprint (owner: Maya R) — OKR1
  - Deliver a simplified pricing + legal MOU template for mid-market customers (target: 2-week turnaround)
  - Solutions eng template: 'Dedicated quickstart' with 3 reference infra patterns
  - Action: Sales playbook workshop (Jul 21) -> owners: Sales/SE/Legal

2) Inference Cost Engineering Blitz (owner: Noah C) — OKR2
  - Roll out KV-prefix caching for top-3 models; measure delta on token ratio and latency
  - Opt-in quantization pilot for 2 enterprise customers (with rollback plan)
  - Measure: weekly token-cost dashboard, hypotheses for next 4 weeks

3) Release Readiness & SLOs (owner: Eleanor L) — OKR3
  - Draft SLOs + error budget policy for Dedicated endpoints
  - On-call runbook and incident postmortem template (executive review Jul 30)
  - Internal tabletop for fallback routing (Aug 5)

4) All-hands & Exec Comms (owner: Samir P) — cross-cutting
  - Two-stage all-hands: 1) priority kickoff (Day 0 — recorded + Q&A), 2) mid-horizon pulse (Day 40)
  - Exec update deck: 8 slides max, include: progress vs KR baselines, 3 blockers, asks
  - Office hours schedule for teams to surface tradeoffs (weekly thru horizon)

80-day Sprintboard (high level timeline)
--------------------------------------
- Day 0 (Jul 28): Publish this canvas + kickoff all-hands (recorded).
- Week 1–2: Finalize OKR baselines; signoff on sales pricing MOU draft; infra experiment configs queued.
- Week 3–6: Run cost-engineering experiments; onboard first enterprise quantization pilot; start Dedicated quickstarts.
- Day 40 (Aug 7): Mid-horizon pulse + exec sync; publish heatmap of OKR progress.
- Week 7–11: Iterate on experiments, close top MR deals, complete SLOs and runbooks.
- Day 80 (Oct 16): Exec review + prepare next horizon canvas.

Communications plan (short)
--------------------------
- Pre-kickoff (this doc): share with execs and LT for comments (deadline Jul 20).
- Kickoff all-hands: 20–25 minute slot with 2 Qs prioritized; collect questions in advance via short form.
- Mid-horizon pulse: targeted 15-minute update + team heatmaps in Slack thread.
- Weekly team office hours: sign-up sheet + central notes doc.

Risk register and mitigations
---------------------------
- Risk: Quantization causes subtle quality regressions -> Mitigation: gated pilots, control prompts, rollback policy, automatic A/B traffic split fallback.
- Risk: Sales pipeline slow due to legal churn -> Mitigation: pre-approved MOU templates + playbook; dedicated legal office hours.
- Risk: Infra cost overshoot if caching effect is lower -> Mitigation: canary configs and automatic throttle to baseline.

Decisions required by execs (timeline)
------------------------------------
- Approve $300k infra burst budget for quantization pilot (decision by Jul 18).
- Signoff on Dedicated MOU template legal language (Jul 22).
- Endorse 80-day OKR set or request revision (Jul 20).

Open questions / discussion points
--------------------------------
- Which customer segments should be prioritized for the quantization pilot? (product vs. revenue-weighted?)
- Tolerance for p99 latency increases for cost improvements — what is acceptable tradeoff?
- Should we fold "developer experience" OKR (tooling for fast onboarding) into Dedicated KR1.3 or treat separately?

Ownership and immediate next steps (this week)
--------------------------------------------
- by Jul 18: Exec decision on infra budget (Eleanor to schedule decision meeting).
- by Jul 20: Finalize OKR wording and baselines (Owners: Maya, Noah, Eleanor).
- Jul 21: Sales playbook workshop run (Samir + Sales leaders).
- Jul 28: Company kickoff all-hands published recording and short FAQ.

Notes to reviewers
-----------------
- This is intentionally compact; assume that each initiative will produce an attached plan (1–2 pages) with milestones and required resources.
- Feedback focus: Are these the right KRs to measure impact on revenue + unit economics? Are there missing high-risk items?
- Please add blocker tickets into Jira epic RWF-2114 and flag anything needing legal or finance review.
